{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build GUI
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - dev

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    environment: github-actions

    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            package: linux-x86_64
          - os: windows-2022
            package: windows
          - os: macos-latest
            package: macos-universal

    env:
      BUILD_PROFILE: ${{ github.ref_name == 'dev' && 'fast_release' || 'release' }}
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            target
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gui-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gui-

      - name: Setup Rust environment
        uses: raftario/setup-rust-action@v1.0.0
        env:
          ACTIONS_ALLOW_UNSECURE_COMMANDS: true

      - if: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' }}
        name: Install Linux build deps
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install --yes \
            libdbus-1-dev \
            libfreetype6-dev \
            libfontconfig1-dev \
            libegl1-mesa-dev \
            libgl1-mesa-dev \
            libwayland-dev \
            libwayland-egl1 \
            libgles2-mesa-dev \
            flatpak \
            flatpak-builder

      - if: ${{ matrix.os == 'windows-2022' }}
        name: Install MSVC ARM64 Build Tools
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $installerPath = "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\setup.exe"
          $installPath = "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Enterprise"
          Start-Process $installerPath -ArgumentList "modify --installPath `"$installPath`" --quiet --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.ARM64.BuildTools.Latest" -Wait -PassThru

      - if: ${{ matrix.os == 'windows-2022' }}
        name: Add Windows ARM64 target
        run: rustup target add aarch64-pc-windows-msvc

      - if: ${{ matrix.os == 'macos-latest' }}
        name: Add macOS targets
        run: rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-apple-darwin

      - name: Build native binary
        if: ${{ matrix.os != 'macos-latest' }}
        run: cargo build --locked -p nitro_gui --profile "${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }}"

      - if: ${{ matrix.os == 'windows-2022 SKIP' }}
        name: Build Windows ARM64 binary
        run: cargo build --locked -p nitro_gui --profile "${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }}" --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc

      - if: ${{ matrix.os == 'macos-latest' }}
        name: Build macOS binaries
        run: |
          cargo build --locked -p nitro_gui --profile "${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }}" --target x86_64-apple-darwin
          cargo build --locked -p nitro_gui --profile "${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }}" --target aarch64-apple-darwin

      - name: Package with cargo-packager (Linux)
        if: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' }}
        run: |
          cargo install --git https://github.com/crabnebula-dev/cargo-packager cargo-packager || true
          cargo-packager --manifest-path crates/gui/Cargo.toml \
            --binaries-dir target/${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }} \
            --profile ${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }} \
            --out-dir dist \
            --formats deb,appimage

      - name: Build Flatpak bundle (Linux)
        if: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' }}
        run: |
          flatpak --user remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
          flatpak --user install -y --noninteractive flathub org.freedesktop.Platform//24.08 org.freedesktop.Sdk//24.08
          rm -rf builddir repo dist/*.flatpak
          flatpak-builder --user --repo=repo --force-clean builddir crates/gui/assets/org.nitrolaunch.Nitrolaunch.json
          flatpak build-bundle repo dist/Nitrolaunch.flatpak org.nitrolaunch.Nitrolaunch

      - name: Package with cargo-packager (Windows x64)
        if: ${{ matrix.os == 'windows-2022' }}
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          cargo install --git https://github.com/crabnebula-dev/cargo-packager cargo-packager | Out-Null
          cargo-packager --manifest-path crates/gui/Cargo.toml `
            --binaries-dir target\${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }} `
            --profile ${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }} `
            --out-dir dist `
            --formats wix

      - name: Package with cargo-packager (macOS)
        if: ${{ matrix.os == 'macos-latest' }}
        run: |
          cargo install --git https://github.com/crabnebula-dev/cargo-packager cargo-packager || true
           # Create a universal binary from both architectures
           mkdir -p target/${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }}
           lipo -create \
             target/x86_64-apple-darwin/${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }}/nitro_gui \
             target/aarch64-apple-darwin/${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }}/nitro_gui \
             -output target/${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }}/nitro_gui
           cargo-packager --manifest-path crates/gui/Cargo.toml \
             --binaries-dir target/${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }} \
             --profile ${{ env.BUILD_PROFILE }} \
             --out-dir dist \
             --formats app,dmg

      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.package }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            dist/*.flatpak
            crates/gui/dist/**",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs a three-platform matrix (Linux, Windows, macOS) with fail-fast set to false, so every matrix job continues to completion even after one fails. Evidence pattern P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242, outcome scenario_passed) supports canceling remaining matrix jobs after a failure to save CI resources while preserving full coverage on successful runs. The change is minimal: flip strategy.fail-fast from false to true. No permissions are weakened, no new secrets or network access are added, and all build/package steps and required checks are retained.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242"]
}
